permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connect to the self-hosted Quiet Hub daemon for agent notifications, home and printer status.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Record a voice question only while the user holds the touchpad on the Agent page.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.desc: Open the phone camera only when the user taps Scan QR, to read the private Quiet Hub setup code.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Optional, for the Day start weather only: the phone position, rounded to about 1 km, is sent to your own Quiet Hub daemon when the page loads. Not stored by the app.
